http/websocket_origin#

Whether a WebSocket upgrade may come from its Origin.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

WebSocketUpgrade(protocols: [], limits: WebSocketLimits(), access: SameOriginWebSockets(), deadline: Duration(seconds: 5.rat()));

Description#

Whether a WebSocket upgrade may come from its Origin.

The server's own URL, from its configuration, is what the Origin is checked against; the Host field of the request is not trusted. A non-browser client that sends no Origin needs a policy of its own.

Public API#

role WebSocketAllowing
